no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Molecular diagnostics-only company (in-vitro diagnostics). Develops PCR/mRNA biomarker-based screening tests for colorectal cancer (ColoAlert, CE-IVD certified in EU; ColoAlert offering ended March 2026 ahead of next-generation mRNA-based replacement) and pancreatic cancer (in-licensed mRNA panel from Liquid Biosciences March 2025; PancAlert stool test in early development). No drug product candidates; no FDA drug clinical trials. Validation studies for diagnostics are not pharma P1/P2/P3 in scope.

10k.note: Filed as a 10-K rather than 20-F despite being a Dutch N.V. — domestic US issuer election

website.note: Molecular cancer screening diagnostics — ColoAlert (CRC) and pancreatic cancer test under development

commercial_product.type: CE-IVD certified molecular diagnostic test for colorectal cancer (multitarget stool DNA + FIT, KRAS/BRAF mutations)
commercial_product.status: Offering wound down March 2026 in favor of next-generation mRNA-based CRC test in development
